title: Quick Fried Khao Khua Dutch Beef Fried-Rice
description: A savory and chewy Dutch dish made with sweet chilli sauce, khao khua, and fried rice, perfect for a kid-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender.
Push the beef and vegetable mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the other side of the skillet.
Add 2 cups of khao khua to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until it is lightly browned and crispy.
Mix the khao khua with the beef and vegetable mixture.
Add the sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have combined.
Serve the Quick Fried Khao Khua Dutch Beef Fried-Rice hot in a Korean brass bowl.
